mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the market anticipates prolonged monetary easing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.1 and 0.2 percentage points respectively in one month signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise as specified.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 2% and UNRATE < 4%), a rising CPIAUCSL (inflation acceleration) exceeding 0.3 percentage points in one month signals central bank policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansions when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1600 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand for housing and durable goods, reducing corporate sales growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1600.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as the market reacts to prolonged monetary easing.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightness regime (UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 3 months), a rising retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.3% in one month signals strong consumer spending, boosting corporate earnings and causing positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during labor market tightness when RSAFS rises > 0.3% in 1 month.
